thread:
alex: Quick sync — I opened a hotfix SDK PR that changes the client header format. Merged locally into my branch but holding on main until console/backend and helm/runtime are aligned. PR: https://git.redwood/dev/sdk/pulls/482

maria: Thanks for the heads up. Which header key changed? need to bump the client lib semver?

alex: It's `X-Redwood-Model` -> `X-Redwood-Model-Id`. Small change, but console backend expects the old key for route selection. I already added a compatibility wrapper but we should coordinate deploy order.

ryan: @alex can you paste the compatibility wrapper? want to verify console won't break in staging (we have a canary this afternoon).

alex: ```js
// compatibility shim in sdk client
const headerKey = opts.useNew ? 'X-Redwood-Model-Id' : 'X-Redwood-Model';
headers[headerKey] = modelId;
// fallback to old key if new key not present on server side
```

maria: ok, so SDK has dual-write for now. That should keep console safe. We still need backend to accept the new key for the runtime routing service. jen, any constraints on runtime helm chart rollout?

jen: Helm side: runtime chart has an env var that names the header we look up: `ROUTER_HEADER_NAME`. We can default to `X-Redwood-Model` and add `X-Redwood-Model-Id` in the next revision, but we should do a canary with both names supported first. That needs a configmap bump and a small migration job.

sam: Timeline check — we have a staging merge window at 16:30 PT. If SDK go-forward is gated on runtime change, sequence should be: 1) update runtime helm to support new key (canary) 2) deploy backend change to read new key 3) merge SDK -> main 4) shift console to require new key. Can we hit that today?

ryan: I can hold console PR until step 4. Backend change is ready in https://git.redwood/dev/backend/pulls/998, but needs a quick infra approval for the helm values. jen, can you tee up the canary values?

jen: On it. I'll push a values file: `values-canary-new-header.yaml` and trigger a canary deploy to `staging-runtime-canary`. Expect ~10m for rollout + smoke tests.

ci-bot: build status — backend PR #998: tests passed (unit), integration job queued on staging (logs: https://ci.redwood/runs/5234).

maria: If the canary passes, I can flip SDK PR to merge and cut a patch release. Alex — pls keep the shim for one more release so older consoles don't break.

alex: Will keep shim for two minor releases, and then remove with a changelog note. I'll add a note to the SDK release PR.

sam: Plan agreed. Owners: jen (canary + helm values), ryan (hold console PR), maria (release cut), alex (shim + release note), backend reviewers please watch #998. I'll coordinate the 16:30 window. :calendar: :ok_hand:

ryan: ack, holding console changes. Will monitor canary and smoke tests.

jen: canary values pushed: https://git.redwood/dev/charts/runtime/commit/3a9f2d4, kicking off deploy now.

ci-bot: deploy started -> staging-runtime-canary (deploy/5235). Expected duration ~8m.

maria: pinging to remind reviewers on SDK PR: https://git.redwood/dev/sdk/pulls/482 — needs one more approval after canary passes.

alex: thanks all. I'll post a short follow-up here after smoke tests.

jen: smoke tests green (logs: https://ci.redwood/runs/5235/logs). No routing errors for both header names.

sam: green light. maria, please cut patch and merge when ready. I'll unlock the merge window.

maria: doing the cut now. Will update once release artifacts are published.

alex: release published (sdk v1.12.3). changelog: https://git.redwood/dev/sdk/releases/tag/v1.12.3 — includes shim and note about header rename.

ryan: merged console changes against new header, validated on staging. All good.

sam: closing the loop — prod rollout scheduled for 02:00 UTC with rolling canary per usual. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
